Zilles 2017 'basal area 37' is a Brodmann-style region. FG3/FG4 (Lorenz et al. 2017) occupy the mid-fusiform gyrus within the territory usually labelled BA37; boundaries are not identical and the Zilles sample location within 37 is not specified here.
Lateral area 37 (posterior ITG/MTG). No Julich v3.1 cytoarchitectonic area; the territory is covered by GapMap-Temporal-to-Parietal.
Medial area 37 (medial fusiform/lingual boundary). No Julich v3.1 area equated with it; CoS1 and Ph1-Ph3 are neighbours but not established equivalents.
Te1 = primary auditory cortex on Heschl's gyrus, equated with BA41 (Morosan et al. 2001); Te1.0/1.1/1.2 are its subdivisions.
Te2 (planum temporale, lateral/posterior to Te1) is commonly equated with BA42 (Morosan et al. 2005; Zachlod et al. 2020) but boundaries differ.
Inferior temporal gyrus BA20. No Julich v3.1 cytoarchitectonic area; GapMap-Frontal-to-Temporal-II / GapMap-Temporal-to-Parietal cover it.
Middle temporal gyrus BA21. No Julich v3.1 area; covered by GapMap-Temporal-to-Parietal.
Te3 on the lateral STG corresponds to part of BA22 (Morosan et al. 2005); BA22 also includes posterior STG territory (TPJ, Te 2) not included here.
Ectorhinal/perirhinal BA36. No Julich v3.1 area 35/36; EC and the parahippocampal Ph1-Ph3 / CoS1 areas are neighbours, not equivalents.
Temporal pole BA38. No Julich v3.1 area; covered by GapMap-Frontal-to-Temporal-I.
